description: The storm intro (PLAN.md 3.1). Each panel sets the scene's 'state' and shows a caption; 'speaker': 'sidekick' shows the caption in the sidekick's speech bubble instead. {sidekick} is replaced with the sidekick's name.

panels.caption: This is the Wildlife Rescue Center. Animals get safe and cozy here.
One night, a big thunderstorm rolled in.
CRASH! The wind knocked the fences down.
The animals got scared and ran off in every direction!

panels.speaker: sidekick
panels.caption: Oh no! The animals are lost all over the map.

panels.speaker: sidekick
panels.caption: We're rangers! Let's find every animal and bring it home.

panels.speaker: sidekick
panels.caption: Walk close to an animal to start a chase. Answer questions to catch it!
